messages:
mira: quick sync: question about canary pins and expiry. should pins created by tenant-scoped canaries auto-expire faster than normal pins?

toni: short answer yes. want shorter TTL so we don't hold capacity for long. but need atomic promotion so stable rollout can claim pin without gap.

alex: +1. add fields: pin_origin(enum), pin_ttl_hint(seconds), pin_intent_id(uuid). record pin_promoted_by and pin_promotion_ts on promotion for audits.

sam: agree. also we need better targeting than a single cohort string. propose shard_labels as list of k=v strings (eg "region=eu","tier=premium"). server should canonicalize and whitelist namespaces.

mira: example manifest: {"variant":"v2.6-canary","pin_origin":"canary","pin_ttl_hint":"1800","pin_intent_id":"uuid-abc","shard_labels":["region=eu","tier=premium"],"promote_token":null}

alex: runtime should treat pin_ttl_hint as advisory; infra may extend TTL based on affinity. include schema_version on manifest for forward compatibility.

deploy-bot: we'll emit pin_expired events to ops stream with payload (variant,tenant_id,shard_labels,expiry_ts). opening event-schema PR.

sam: add safety cap default so canary pins can't take >N% tenant capacity. manifest can opt into capacity_override but require approval.

toni: i'll draft RFC covering fields, label canonicalization, probe endpoint (GET /pins?tenant=&variant=) and migration notes. mira pls review.

mira: will review and add telemetry queries (canary churn, expiry->promotion lag). closing thread.
